daily_kpi: MET before this additional study by distinct real-data hypothesis backtests on 2026-11-26; this run is additional research, not a quota claim
data_scope: CFTC TFF futures-only Bitcoin CME contract 133741, 2018-04-10 to 2026-11-17 (450 rows; known 2025-09-30 to 2026-01-20 catch-up period excluded from events/history); FRED/Coinbase CBBTCUSD 2016-11-25 to 2026-11-25 (3652 daily observations); 375 accepted weekly events
disposition: INCONCLUSIVE — the frozen validation/test and paired-event criteria do not establish incremental predictive value or decisive inferiority

event_construction.weekly_report_design: Tuesday report dates; first Coinbase BTCUSD close on or after report_date + 14 calendar days

limitations: CFTC leveraged-fund classifications do not reveal the intent of individual positions; gross shorts may include cash-and-carry basis trades, directional positions and other strategies.
CFTC code 133741 represents CME Bitcoin futures only, not offshore perpetual swaps or the global derivatives market.

A fixed 14-day lag is conservative for the historical weekly schedule; known 2025 shutdown catch-up reports are excluded. Holiday-shifted report dates are retained, but any interval below six days fails closed as a cadence change. The sample is frozen at the 2026-11-26 as-of date.
Current CFTC history may reflect revised positions and trader classifications; exact historical release timestamps are unavailable for the full history.
Coinbase CBBTCUSD is a single-venue daily 5 p.m. Pacific price series; raw observations are not committed or redistributed.
Current FRED vintage is used; historical ALFRED point-in-time vintages are not reconstructed.
Forecast-only: no causal claim, trading P&L, transaction-cost model, profitability, live strategy or deployment conclusion.

methodology.crowding_feature: gross leveraged-fund short positions divided by total open interest
methodology.crowding_percentile_lookback: prior 52 non-backlog reports only; current report excluded
methodology.target: log1p(next-five-observation BTC downside semivariance in percentage-points squared)
methodology.training_rule: training signal_date and target_end_date must both be strictly earlier than current signal_date

price_source.source: Coinbase daily BTCUSD close distributed by FRED, 5 p.m. Pacific Time
